questions.label: most sold products
questions.question: What are the most sold products?
questions.dax: EVALUATE TOPN(10, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('DimProduct'[Product], 'DimProduct'[Category], "Quantity Sold", [Total Quantity], "Total Sales", [Total Sales]), [Total Quantity], DESC) ORDER BY [Total Quantity] DESC

questions.label: sales by month
questions.question: How have sales changed by month?
questions.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('DimDate'[YearMonth], "Total Sales", [Total Sales], "Gross Profit", [Gross Profit], "Orders", [Orders]) ORDER BY 'DimDate'[YearMonth]
